description: This Java source file defines a class named AddDeviceAddressRequest, which extends a class called Request. It appears to be part of a mock Zigbee core request handling system, specifically for adding a device address identified by an EUI-64 identifier. The class includes a constructor to initialize the request with an ID and an EUI-64 string, and an execute method that sends back a response indicating the action was completed.
